capture_method: Playwright-rendered www.airbnb.com search and room pages; listing photos fetched from the a0.muscache.com URLs those pages reference (im_w=720)
notes: Covers every managed media file under static/images/; the seed database is generated at build time from the tracked source_data_*.json snapshots (see .build-generated-seed).
Every entry is byte- and hash-verified by scripts/check_asset_inventory.py during the Docker build.
All source URLs are the upstream a0.muscache.com photo URLs referenced by the captured listing pages, requested at im_w=720.

The CDN served these originals as PNG; they were re-encoded to JPEG (quality 85) so the .jpg files are JPEG, and the recorded bytes/SHA-256 are of the re-encoded files: static/images/listings/1212251232135201683/02.jpg, static/images/listings/1212251232135201683/03.jpg, static/images/listings/1212251232135201683/09.jpg, static/images/listings/33645833/02.jpg.
The Airbnb logo (static/icons/airbnb_logo.svg, fill set to #FF385C because the upstream inline SVG uses currentcolor) and favicon (static/icons/favicon.png) are tracked in git.
